name: Review code
description: Senior-style review: bugs, risks, edge cases and simpler designs.
prompt: Review this code for bugs, risks and simpler alternatives:
guidance: Act as senior code reviewers. Look for correctness bugs, security issues, unhandled edge cases, performance traps and a simpler design. Quote the lines you mean. Separate must-fix problems from nice-to-haves, and don't invent problems that aren't there.
